facts.claim: There were 4,137 miles of railways in the Presidency at the close of 1904.
facts.quote: At the close of the year 1904 there were 4,137 miles of railways in the Presidency.

facts.claim: The Great Indian Peninsula Railway has been a state line since 1900.
facts.quote: Since 1900 the Great Indian Peninsula Railway has been a state line, worked by a company.

facts.claim: The Bombay, Baroda, and Central India Railway was purchased by the state in 1906.
facts.quote: The Bombay, Baroda, and Central India Railway is a guaranteed line which was purchased by the state in 1906.
